title: decrypt_aes128/256_gcm functions are dead code; AES-GCM path is unreachable
description: decrypt.rs defines decrypt_aes128_gcm() and decrypt_aes256_gcm() (lines 169-198) both marked #[allow(dead_code)]. The dispatch in decrypt() explicitly returns UnsupportedAlgorithm for AES-GCM OIDs before it would reach them (lines 58-63). These functions are dead code that will never be called through the current logic. They will confuse a contributor who wonders why GCM is stubbed out in one place but apparently implemented elsewhere. They should be removed until AuthEnvelopedData is actually implemented.
